scenarios.name: condition-true-cast-without-paying
scenarios.why: An opponent controls an Island (seat 1) and seat 0 controls a Mountain, so the condition holds and Mogg Salvage may be cast without paying its mana cost: with an empty pool it still resolves and destroys the artifact.

scenarios.name: condition-false-opponent-has-no-island
scenarios.why: An opponent must control an Island; seat 1 controls none, so the free cast is unavailable and, with an empty pool, the spell is not offered.

scenarios.name: condition-false-no-own-mountain
scenarios.why: Seat 0 must control a Mountain; it controls none, so the free cast is unavailable and, with an empty pool, the spell is not offered.

scenarios.name: condition-false-still-castable-for-mana
scenarios.why: The free cast is conditional but the mana cost is not: without the opponent's Island, seat 0 pays {2}{R} and still destroys the artifact.
